subject: POC activation checkpoints — org invite, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering timeline
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff - environment prerequisites and dates

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Novamed infra team reviewed Redwood's MAP doc and we want to lock the POC activation window. To make the internal change freeze and security review work, we need a clear checklist for the items below so our SREs can schedule changes: 

- Org invite & role mapping (who should be admin/readonly)
- API key provisioning pattern (short-lived vs long-lived; rotate cadence)
- IP allowlist ranges and any requirement for outbound NAT
- VPC peering stub and required peering CIDRs + who opens the ticket

Target POC run: week of 2026-07-06 (we have an integration blackout the week prior). Can you confirm what you need from our side and whether the suggested week works?

Also adding Chris (infra) in case he wants to jump in on CIDR questions.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Dir, Cloud Platform — Novamed Health
Attachment: pec-priority-list.xlsx (stub, 18 KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - environment prerequisites and dates

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Confirmed: week of 2026-07-06 works on our side. Below is a proposed gating checklist and who owns each item. I attached an edited MAP page with the timeline and a sample VPC request YAML.

Gating checklist (proposed):
1) Org & workspace: Redwood will send an org invite to the primary admin. Please confirm the admin email; default recommendation is one Novamed admin + one Novamed readonly. (owner: Redwood / action: accept invite)
2) API keys: we can create two API keys: a short-lived key (30d) for the POC and a longer-lived test key for integration debugging. Keys are tenant-scoped and we recommend rotating short-lived keys every 15 days during the POC. (owner: Redwood to create; Novamed to confirm usage)
3) IP allowlist: please provide the minimal CIDR blocks your egress will originate from. We support allowlisting by CIDR or by named gateway if you prefer. (owner: Novamed)
4) VPC peering: we will provide peering configs and required routes. Peering needs a maintenance window on your side to accept/route. I attached a sample YAML for the ticket. (owner: Novamed to open peering ticket; Redwood to accept)

Attachments included: redwood-map-v0.3.pdf (MAP with timeline, 1.2 MB), novamed-vpc-request.yaml (sample ticket, 6 KB).

A couple of notes:
- For the org invite, use the email you want to be the POC admin. Once you accept, we will provision a POC org with dedicated API quota.
- If your security team needs an audit package (SOC2 evidence, retention defaults), Lauren can share a pared-down bundle — looping her in.

Next steps: can you send the admin email + CIDR ranges by Monday 2026-06-29? If not, we can slide the POC by one week but prefer to keep 07/06.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-map-v0.3.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB); novamed-vpc-request.yaml (YAML, 6 KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - environment prerequisites and dates

Elena — quick clarifications from security/ops: 

- Org invite: please invite elena.torres+admin@novamed.com (recommended) and elena.torres+readonly@novamed.com for auditing. We will grant 'Org Admin' to the first and 'Viewer' to the second. If you'd rather use an SSO group, tell us the group email.
- API key model: for the POC we prefer short-lived keys (30d) generated by Redwood. We will deliver a rotation webhook if you want automatic key rotation during the POC — would you like that enabled?
- IP allowlist: to reduce scope, can you provide only the egress CIDRs for the testing subnet(s)? We will accept a /29 minimum per endpoint. If you expect dynamic egress, we can use a NAT gateway hostname instead, but that requires extra firewall rules on your side.
- VPC peering: when you open the peering ticket, please include your ASN (if using BGP) and the specific route table IDs you will accept. Our peering docs call this out in section 3.

I can produce a cut-down SOC2 evidence packet (control mapping + ingestion instructions) for your security review; suggest we wait until the org invite is accepted.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Chris Lowry <chris.lowry@novamed.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - environment prerequisites and dates

Thanks — quick update from our infra team (Chris):

- Admin email: elena.torres+admin@novamed.com (we'll send the invite this afternoon).
- CIDRs: testing egress will come from 54.210.32.0/28 and 54.210.48.0/28. Those are our static egress pools for the lab. Please accept /29 or wider; we provided the /28 to be conservative.
- Peering ticket: opened — ticket ID PEER-4921. I've attached the peering request text. Our peering window is available Sat 2026-07-10 02:00–04:00 UTC (we prefer low-traffic windows). If Redwood can accept at that time, we'll proceed.

One ask: can Redwood limit the publicly routable ranges for the POC to those two /28s (rather than open to the wider subnet we originally sent)? We want to minimize exposure during testing.

If everything looks good from your side we'll accept the invite and provide a test key once you confirm.

Thanks,
Elena
Dir, Cloud Platform — Novamed Health
Attachment: peering-ticket-4921.txt (stub, 2 KB)
